Company: Enabled Talent
Location: Greater Sudbury, Ontario — on-site
Type: Full-time, paid internship — 52 weeks, at least 35 hours per week


Application deadline: November 30, 2026.


About Enabled Talent
Enabled Talent is a North American inclusion technology company developing accessible digital tools for people with disabilities and the employers, educational institutions, and community organizations that support them. Our work helps make learning, employment, and everyday participation more accessible.


About the Role
We are looking for an AI / Data Engineer Intern to help build the data and AI systems behind our platform. Working with our engineering and product team, you will gain practical experience developing accessible, responsible technology.


What You Will Do

- Build and maintain data pipelines.
- Clean, organize, and prepare data for AI models.
- Help develop matching and recommendation features.
- Evaluate model accuracy, fairness, and potential bias across user groups.
- Build dashboards and reports for internal and partner use.
- Work with APIs, databases, and cloud services.
- Write clear, documented code and follow privacy and data security practices.
- Collaborate with the team to test and improve platform features.
- 

What We Are Looking For

- Education in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant training and practical experience.
- Working knowledge of Python and SQL.
- Familiarity with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
- Understanding of databases and data modelling.
- Interest in accessibility and responsible technology.
- Clear communication, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.
- 

Nice to Have

- Experience with large language models, embeddings, or recommendation systems.
- Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
- Knowledge of responsible AI and bias testing.
- Relevant personal projects, GitHub contributions, or hackathon experience.
- 

Internship Eligibility
Under the funding conditions provided for this position, candidates must:

- Be at least 18 years old.
- Reside in Canada and be legally eligible to work in Canada.
- Be a new entrant to the workforce, be transitioning to a new career, or be unemployed or underemployed and entering a new field.
- Not have previously participated in an NOHFC-funded internship under the 2020 Mandate.
- Reside in Greater Sudbury, the Northern Ontario community where the position is based, once hired.


What We Offer

- A paid internship with practical experience in AI and data engineering.
- Guidance and mentorship from our engineering and product team.
- Experience developing accessible digital products.
- An opportunity to contribute to technology that supports people with disabilities.
- 

How to Apply
Send your résumé and a brief introduction to aman@enabledtalent.com , using “AI / Data Engineer Intern” as the subject line. You may also include a portfolio, GitHub profile, or relevant project examples.


Enabled Talent is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and candidates from diverse backgrounds. Accommodations are available on request throughout the recruitment and selection process.


NOHFC Support



- This opportunity is proudly supported by Northern Ontario Heritage Fund Corporation and is funded through the Workforce Development Program. Eligibility requirements of the program can be found on the NOHFC Workforce Development Program website.
fit_why: Python/SQL/ML data pipeline work fits well; on-site Sudbury ignored per rules

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.

Primary Function of Position 
 The Global Access, Value and Economics (GAVE) organization at Intuitive is seeking a highly motivated, hard-working, and professional AI/ML Engineer Intern to join our team for Summer 2027. The AI/ML Engineer Intern will support GAVE’s mission of generating clinical evidence to drive the adoption of robotic-assisted surgery. They will work within the Global Access and Evidence Management Center of Excellence to develop a system to optimize evidence management and synthesis processes. They will design a tool to identify, deduplicate, validate, and ingest new publications related to Intuitive products. They will also work with the team to integrate existing large language model (LLM) pipelines into this solution. The intern will get hands-on experience with software development, data management, machine learning, and systems design thinking. Beyond technical skills, this internship will require effective communication with numerous cross-functional stakeholders.
 Essential Job Duties 
 
• Design an end-to-end data pipeline to optimize critical evidence management, synthesis, and generation processes. 
• Implement and automate publication search and deduplication strategies. 
• Assist in integrating additional large language model (LLM) workflows into this system. 
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop the solution. 
• Present and interpret findings to a broad range of teams across the organization.

Required Skills and Experience 
 
• Self-motivated individual with a strong interest in data science and machine learning. 
• Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and address the needs of multiple stakeholders. 
• Excellent mix of communication and technical skills to engage effectively across all audiences. 
• Self-driven problem solver who can work with minimal supervision. 
• Strong desire to learn and grow in the field of data science and machine learning. 
• Proficiency with Python programming language. 
• Strong understanding of relational databases and SQL. 
• Solid grasp of machine learning concepts and algorithms. 
• Understanding of systems thinking and system design principles. University Hiring Program Eligibility Requirements: 
 
• University Enrollment: Must be currently enrolled in and returning to an accredited degree-seeking academic program after the internship. 
• Internship Work Period: Must be available to work full-time (approximately 40 hours per week) during a 10–12 week period starting May or June. Specific start dates are shared during the recruiting process. 
• Internship will be remote/hybrid with opportunity for on-site meetings at a minimum of 3 times during the course of the internship. Required Education and Training 
 
• Current enrollment in a Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or related degree-seeking program at the Bachelor’s or Master’s level. Working Conditions 
 
• None Preferred Skills and Experience 
 
• Experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar), including prompt engineering and structured outputs. 
• Experience with Agentic AI workflows. 
• Experience with building ETL/data ingestion pipelines for Snowflake. 
• Experience with NLP techniques such as vector embeddings and semantic similarity. 
• Familiarity with R is a plus. 
• Experience with scikit-learn is a plus. 
• Familiarity with statistical methods, systematic literature reviews, and meta-analysis is a plus.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.
 Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.
 Mandatory Notices 
 U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer:  In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.
 Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).  
 For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 
 We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.
 Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:
 Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.
 We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay (paid at an hourly rate), benefits, and a housing allowance. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including relevant skills and experience for this internship, degree-seeking academic program (PhD, Master’s, Bachelor’s, etc), year in school, and location. The hourly rate is prorated against the intern program salaries listed and total program compensation will be based on internship duration.
fit_why: Python/SQL/ML pipeline work fits; data/LLM focus, not core SWE
